book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Oburhegesi bwa Yeesu ngahe burhengeere?
Lusiku luguma, oku Yeesu ali ayigiriza abantu omu Nju ya Nnamahanga n'okubala oMwanzi Mwinja, ho n'aho abakulu b'abadaahwa n'abigiriza b'amarhegeko, haguma n'abashamuka b'aBayaahudi baahulukira.
Baava baamubaza ntya: «Orhubwire oku burhegesi bwa nde oli waajira ebi bintu. Nde ye waguhaaga obu burhegesi?»
Yeesu abashubiza ntya: «Naani, nababaza echibazo chiguma, munshubize:
‹Obubatiizo bwa Yohaana ka bwarhengeraga empingu changwa emw'abantu?›»
Babwirana ntya bonyine oku bonyine: «Rhukaderha okw'empingu, arhubaza gichi charhumaga rhurhamuyemeera.
Kandi rhugashubiza oku emw'abantu, olubaga looshi lwarhuyirhiisa amabaale, kwenge lwali luyemereere oku Yohaana aliiri muleebi.»
Ntyo ku bamushubiize oku barhenji ngahe bwarhengeraga.
Yeesu aja ababwira ntya: «Ko n'oko naani, ntababwira oku burhegesi bwa nde njira ebi bintu.»
Omugani gw'abahinzi babi
Kandi Yeesu ashuba kubachiira guno mugani: «Haliiri muntu muguma wahingaga eshwa ly'emizabiibu, aliyadiisa abahinzi n'okubalama siku zinene.
Egihe ch'ogushaluula chabeere chagera ho, arhuma omuja waage emwa bala bahinzi mpu bamuheerezage amaage malehe m'eshwa. Aliko abo bahinzi bashuurha oyo muja n'okumugalula maboko moomu.
Nyina eshwa ashuba gurhuma owindi muja. Naye bamushuurha, bamudukanga, banamugalula maboko moomu.
Ashuba gurhuma omuja wa gasharhu. Bamukoromesa, banamukabula embuga.
Nyina eshwa aderha ntya: ‹Gurhe naaja naajira? Naaja narhuma mugala waani muzigirwa, nkabaga yeewe bamukenga.›
Aliko balaala bahinzi babeere bamulangiira, babwirana ntya: ‹Tala, oyuula yi waaba nyina agashambala! Rhumuyirhe, y'agashambala kaba keerhu.›
Bamukuula omu shwa, banamuyirha.» Yeesu aja abaza abantu ntya: «Nyina eshwa gurhe nj'ajira aboola bahinzi?
Nj'agaluka, nj'anayirha aboola bahinzi, nj'anaheereza abandi eshwa.» Abantu babeere bayunva ntyo, baaderha ntya: «Ebiri ntya birhahira bikaba!»
Aliko Yeesu abaloleereza, aderha ntya: «Echi chinwa chiyandikirwe gurhe chiderhere?
Ngasi muntu nji wakumbagala kw'eryo baale nj'avunagulika; n'eyi nji lyarhogera ko nji lyamuhomboola.»
Ho n'aho, abigiriza b'amarhegeko n'abakulu b'abadaahwa bashonda ogushweka Yeesu, bulaala bali bayinji oku bo baderherwe mw'ogu mugani. Aliko bayuubaha abantu.
Echibazo ch'ogufurha ekooli lya Kayizaari

Abo bakulu b'aBayaahudi barhondera guhenguuza Yeesu. Baamurhumira abantu b'okumuneeka, baliiri kubonekana nka bali b'okuli yi bamufarhira omu nderho, n'okulengera eyo njira bagale kumuhaana omu maboko m'omurhegesi w'egihugo.
Aba bantu baabaza Yeesu ntya: «Mwigiriza, rhuyinji oku oderha n'okuyigiriza bwinja; orhajira kaboolo, aliko oyigiriza enjira ya Nnamahanga gukulikirana n'okuli.
Orhubwirage leero, k'amarhegeko meerhu mayemereere changwa malahiire gufurha ekooli emwa Kayizaari?»
Aliko Yeesu amenya obulyaalya bwabo, ababaza ntya:
«Munyereke egicheri chiguma ch'edinaari. Giheekere eshusho n'eziino lya nde?» Baashubiza ntya: «Biri bya Kayizaari.»
Yeesu aja ababwira ntya: «Mugende mwaheereza Kayizaari ebiri byaage, na Nnamahanga naye ebiri byaage.»
Bafundwa kumufarhira oku chiguma omu binwa byaage embere z'olubaga. Basoomererwa egishubizo chaage, baava baasira.
Echibazo ch'ogufuuka kw'abafu
Buzinda bw'aho, aBasadukaayo baguma baaja emwa Yeesu. aBasadukaayo bo barhayemeeraga obufuuke bw'abafu. Bayinja kubaza Yeesu ntya:
«Mwigiriza, tala oku Muusa arhuyandikiire ntya: ‹Nk'omulume aligwerhe omukazi, aliko agafa buzira mwana, mwene waabo anarhoola oyo mukazi n'okuburhira nyagufa abaana.›
Leero haliiri bazaana mushanvu ba nda nguma. Omwambere ashaba n'ogufa buzira mwana.
Owakabiri naye ayingira ola mukazi, naye afa buzira mwana.
N'owagasharhu naye ko n'oko. Byaaba ntyo oku booshi mushanvu, baafa buzira kuleka abaana.
Aha buzinda, ola mukazi naye afa.
Leero amango m'ogufuuka, oyo mukazi nj'aba wa nde? Bulaala aliiri mukaabo booshi oku bali mushanvu!»
Yeesu abashubiza ntya: «Mu lino gulu, abalume n'abakazi yi bashabana.
Aliko abaganjirwe kulama mw'elyo gulu lyayinja n'ogufuuka gurhenga omu bafu nji barhaashaba changwa gushabwa.
Barhaakanafa, bulaala bali kuguma na bamalahika, bali bagala ba Nnamahanga kwenge bafuukire.

Muusa ayerekeene bwinjabwinja oku abafu nji bafuuka. Omu mandiko maage aderhere elugulu w'egishaka chagulumiraga. Yeewe aderhere oku Nnaweerhu ali ‹Nnamahanga wa Abrahaamu, Nnamahanga wa Isaka na Nnamahanga wa Yakobo.›»
Yeesu ashuba kuderha ntya: «Nnamahanga arhali w'abafu, aliko w'abalamire; kwenge oku yeewe booshi balamire.»
Abigiriza baguma b'amarhegeko bashubiza ntya: «Mwigiriza, waderhere bwinja.»
Barhagishubiraga chiro kubaza liguma.
Krisitu na Daawudi
Yeesu abaza abantu baliiri ahoola ntya: «Gurhe abantu bakaderha mpu Krisitu ali mugala wa Daawudi?
Daawudi yenyine aderhere ntya omu gitaabu ch'eNanga:

content.text: guhika amango nji naajira bashombanyi baawe ndabarhiro yaawe.”›

content: Leero akonva Daawudi amuyirikire Nnaweerhu, gurhe akaja aba mugala waage?»
Yeesu abwira abigirizwa baage bachilange n'abigiriza b'amarhegeko
Abantu booshi babeere bali bayunviriza Yeesu, abwira abigirizwa baage ntya:
«Muchilange oku bigiriza b'amarhegeko. Basiima guchilambagiza n'efulema zileehere, n'okulamuswa n'obukenge ah'abantu banene bali, okuyikala oku ntebe z'embere omu masinagoogi n'omu madinye.
Bananyaga abashumbakazi ebintu byaabo byooshi. N'omu guchisiisa, banajira amasaala maleehere. Abo bantu, nji baahanwa bweneene.»
